title: 2026 NFL Draft big board: Ohio State's Caleb Downs is No. 1 among top 50 prospects

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: 2026 NFL Draft big board: Ohio State's Caleb Downs is No. 1 among top 50 prospects
sources.description: Yahoo Sports NFL Draft expert Charles McDonald lays out his top 50 prospects of the 2026 NFL Draft. It includes Fernando Mendoza, the presumptive No. 1 overall pick, at No. 4. One other QB made the list — LSU's Garrett Nussmeier.
